PROJECT INITIALIZATION: SOUTH AFRICAN & INTERNATIONAL RESEARCH PEPTIDE VENTURE (MIKE & IVAN)

OBJECTIVE:
Architect a compliant, high-conversion two-domain e-commerce and research education ecosystem for selling HPLC-verified Research Use Only (RUO) lyophilized peptides in South Africa and internationally.

CORE CATALOGUE (PHASE 1 SKU MATRIX):
1. Tissue Repair: BPC-157 (5mg/10mg), TB-500 (5mg/10mg), Wolverine Blend (BPC-157 5mg + TB-500 5mg).
2. Metabolic Research: Retatrutide (5mg/10mg), Tirzepatide (5mg/10mg), Semaglutide (5mg).
3. GH Axis: CJC-1295 No DAC (5mg), Ipamorelin (5mg), CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin Blend (5mg/5mg).
4. Longevity & Cellular: GHK-Cu (50mg), Glow/Klow Blends, MOTS-c (10mg), NAD+ (500mg).
5. Ancillaries: Sterile Bacteriostatic Water (0.9% Benzyl Alcohol - 10ml/30ml).

AGENT DIRECTIVES & DELIVERABLES:

1. ROXY (UI/UX, Brand Architecture & Funnel Strategy):
- Design a "Two-Domain" Decoupled Funnel Architecture inspired by HNR Labs (Education Hub) + Cellixa Labs (Age-Gated Commercial Storefront).
- Map the complete UI/UX wireframe for the Commercial Storefront: 18+ Age-Verification Modal, Mandatory RUO Checkout Checkbox ("I confirm I am a qualified researcher and these compounds are strictly for in-vitro laboratory research, not for human consumption"), Interactive CoA Batch Lookup Portal, and Product Detail Pages displaying CAS Numbers, Molecular Formulas, Amino Acid Sequences, and HPLC Purity Badges (>99%).
- Design the SEO & Paid Ad Funnel strategy that routes Meta/Google traffic through the Educational Hub to prevent ad-account flags.

2. JACK (Backend, Payment Rails & Inventory Engine):
- Architect a resilient, decoupled headless commerce backend (Node.js/Express + React/Vite) supporting multi-currency pricing (ZAR, USD, GBP, EUR).
- Design a multi-rail Payment Gateway Router capable of handling high-risk classifications: integrate Instant EFT (SA domestic), automated USDT/USDC/BTC crypto checkout, and webhook adapters for international High-Risk Credit Card Merchant processors.
- Build the database schema for Batch/Lot Tracking so every SKU links dynamically to its downloadable PDF Certificate of Analysis (HPLC/MS) via vial QR codes.

3. CHARLIE (Automation, Compliance Logic & Export Engine):
- Build automated geo-fencing and shipping compliance rules: auto-generate international customs packets (Commercial Invoice with exact chemical names, CAS numbers, HS Code 2937/3822, CoA, and SDS) for every international order.
- Enforce automated keyword compliance scrubbing across product descriptions and customer support bots (blocking any human dosing, medical claims, or consumption terminology).

EXECUTION:
Generate a comprehensive, step-by-step Phase 1 Launch Blueprint covering:
A) Brand & Domain Structure
B) Full Technical Stack & Payment Architecture
C) Supplier Vetting & Third-Party HPLC Testing Protocol
D) 30-Day Go-To-Market & SEO Execution Plan
